build_decoder_subclass: build a python module that subclasses FairseqDecoder and implements extract_features and output_layer methods
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on a FairseqDecoder subclass with prev_output_tokens and optional encoder_out
get_normalized_probs: get normalized probabilities or log probabilities from a decoder's network output using get_normalized_probs
review_max_positions: review the FairseqDecoder max_positions method to check the maximum supported input sequence length
prepare_onnx_export: prepare a FairseqDecoder instance for ONNX export by calling prepare_for_onnx_export_
